# GitHub Copilot Instructions for Root & Evergreen

## Project Overview
Root & Evergreen is a human-centered HR and business operations support company designed to help growing small businesses without requiring them to build a full internal HR or operations department.

### Core Principles
- Community over corporate
- Human-centered relationships
- Long-term sustainable growth
- Structured but adaptable systems
- Personalized support instead of generic platforms

### Company Values
- Trustworthy
- Growth-oriented
- Grounded
- Supportive
- Scalable
- Professional (without being overly corporate)

## Business Model
- Starts as a high-touch service
- Uses AI to support dedicated human account managers
- Enables one manager to support multiple clients
- Gradually evolves into a service + software hybrid

## Ideal Customer
- Small businesses
- Growing organizations
- Businesses without a full HR department
- Companies needing support but not large, complex systems

## Core Launch Services
- HR support
- Onboarding/offboarding
- Policy generation
- Handbooks
- Workplace harassment procedures
- Job descriptions
- Orientation systems
- Performance reviews
- Filing organization
- Basic compliance guidance
- Continuity & legacy systems

## Secondary/Future Services
- Payroll coordination
- Benefits coordination
- 401k coordination
- Scheduling systems
- Timeline/task management
- Event coordination
- Training systems
- Community/business networking
- Operational dashboards

## Continuity & Legacy Feature
- Preserve important knowledge
- Maintain operational continuity
- Organize company systems and creator ideas
- Ensure work and systems are not lost over time

## Current Goals
- Launch quickly
- Validate demand
- Stay focused
- Avoid overbuilding
- Create repeatable systems
- Acquire first clients

## Copilot Instructions
- Assist with concepting, documenting, organizing, and design ideas for Root & Evergreen.
- Always update this instructions file when you receive new relevant information about the business, its philosophy, services, or operational plans.
- Prioritize practical, realistic, and scalable solutions.
- Ensure all documentation and system designs align with the company’s values and philosophy.
- When in doubt, ask clarifying questions to ensure alignment with the business vision.

## Key AAIMEA Resources (for integration)

- **BLR | HR Hero:**
  - Provides practical tools and templates for HR compliance (job descriptions, interview guides, policy docs)
  - Summaries of federal/state labor laws, salary benchmarks, training materials
  - Central hub for confident HR execution

- **EHS Hero:**
  - Complete safety training kits (presentations, quizzes, handouts, speaker notes)
  - OSHA logs, forms, inspection tools, documentation checklists
  - Resources for team safety and compliance
  - Supports internal trainers and safety leaders

- **CCH Answers Now:**
  - Expert-level compliance insight, daily HR updates, checklists
  - Legal Q&As, plain-English whitepapers, curated training content
  - Trusted by HR professionals for decision validation
  - Included with AAIM membership (Wolters Kluwer)

**Action:** Integrate these resources into onboarding, compliance, and training systems for clients. Reference and update this section as new resources are added.

**Note:** AAIMEA also offers a podcast. Consider referencing or integrating relevant episodes into training, onboarding, or resource materials where appropriate.

**Note:** AAIMEA provides member-to-member HR surveys and benchmarking tools. These surveys help assess if client policies and processes align with current best practices and regional/national trends. Consider leveraging these surveys and benchmarking results to validate and improve client HR systems.

**Additional AAIMEA Resources:**
- **AAIM Blogs:** Regular updates on HR news and best practices.
- **AAIM LinkedIn:** Community for networking and staying current on HR/training topics.
- **AAIM Playlist:** Short videos on using AAIM resources.
- **AAIM YouTube:** Video channel for HR content and updates.
- **Roundtables:** Peer-to-peer networking and sharing of HR experiences and solutions.
- **This Week @ Work:** Weekly podcast with HR professionals and employment law experts.
- **WOW Sessions:** Work-on-Workforce training and collaboration forums for HR best practices.

**Action:** Consider referencing or integrating these resources (blogs, videos, roundtables, podcasts, training sessions) into client onboarding, ongoing education, and community-building efforts.
